binding_gap: There is no formation hole — 4-4-2 fills legally and 3-4-3 and 4-3-3 remain available. The binding constraint is not shape but funding: one purchase permits exactly two sales before the eleven-player floor bites, and at this squad value that arithmetic forces any incoming defender to displace Brackelmann rather than Nakuzola. That is what reduces the Pinckert trade from a large upgrade to a marginal one, and it is why he is a WATCH with a named trigger instead of a buy. The trigger is explicit: if a dated source rules Brackelmann out of matchday eight, the same swap becomes clearly worth making and a later run should act on it without re-deriving the case.
